verdict.rationale: Strong first-party docs show Statsig runs A/B/n and multivariate (A/B/n, Layers) experiments with hypotheses, primary/secondary metrics via Scorecard, randomized control/test groups, and metric lift reporting with confidence intervals, plus Autotune multi-armed bandit for identifying winning variants. This directly matches the story of running experiments on flags and surfacing which variation wins. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the win-detection UI beyond docs, and no third-party case study confirming metric-lift accuracy in practice.
